MOHW and ko.wikipedia give 2008-02-29 (his 이임식 day), and he stayed on as 무임소 국무위원 for the 2008-03-03 국무회의. Researcher may prefer 2008-02-29.

보건복지가족부 had no minister from 2008-02-29 to 2008-03-12 (the first 이명박 cabinet on 2008-02-29 left it unfilled, 관보 제16703호). Acting entries for 문창진 (2008-02-29) and 이봉화 (2008-03-01..03-12) are inferred from the vice-minister list, since no report naming the 장관 직무대행 was found.

Exit dates differ from the MOHW 역대장관 list for most spells. MOHW usually prints the day before the successor's start. This roster uses the reported day of the resignation acceptance, 면직 or 이임식 when one was found (주양자 1998-04-28, 최선정 2001-03-21, 김근태 2005-12-30, 유시민 2007-05-22, 김성이 2008-08-06, 전재희 2010-08-30, 임채민 2013-03-11, 진영 2013-09-30, 정진엽 2017-07-21, 권덕철 2022-05-25) and the successor's start otherwise (inferred_from_successor). [verifier] 조규홍 was changed to 2025-07-22 (inferred_from_successor) because no exit event for him was found and MOHW's 2025-07-21 is its day-before convention.

For 최선정 (2001), dismissal and 사표 수리 were reported on 2001-03-21, while 김원길's gazette date is 2001-03-23. This leaves a one-day gap on 2001-03-22 that is probably an artefact of the paperwork (MOHW ends 최선정 on 2001-03-22). The verifier added an inferred acting entry for 차관 장석준 on that day; the successor was abroad when named (문화일보 2001-03-22).
For 진수희 (2011), her 이임식 was on 2011-09-19, two days after 임채민's gazette appointment date (2011-09-17). The end is set to 2011-09-17 (inferred_from_successor).

For 김모임 (1998), the appointment was announced on 1998-04-30 and the 임명장 was given on 1998-05-01. With no gazette file before 2001 the start follows the 임명장 day and MOHW. If the legal date was 1998-04-30 the vacancy after 주양자 shrinks to one day.

Two transcript rows outside every spell are speaker-label errors. One is '보건복지부장관 이성호' (2002-07-25, meeting 30264, 1 speech, while 김성호 spoke 163 times), and the other is '보건복지부장관 김홍신' (2003-10-29, meeting 31487, 1 speech, while 김화중 spoke 190 times). Neither held the office in the window (이성호 was minister in 1995-1996 per MOHW). These are also the coverage_gaps.csv leads for this lineage, together with 차흥봉, 최선정, 김원길, 이태복 and 김성호, which are all in the roster.
